system.longDesc:
Requirement: Telekinesis (Novice)

Cost: 1 PP

Time: Major action

Target Number: 9

Test: None

You can strike targets up to 10 yards away with blasts of kinetic force. You make a normal ranged attack test against the target using Accuracy (Telekinesis). If successful, the target takes 1d6 + Willpower bludgeoning damage.
